narr: A cold front moved into a very warm, moist airmass and generated thunderstorms. Temperatures in the warm sector were near record highs when the front moved through. Some of the storms produced large hail and heavy rain that led to flash flooding.
ev: Thunderstorms produced heavy rain. San Antonio Fire Department rescued a person from a flooded drainage ditch near Tioga Dr. and I-10 in northwestern San Antonio.

Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. Medina County 911 Dispatch received a call from an individual who was trapped in their vehicle that had been swept off Park Road 37 in high water at Mescal Creek. On the afternoon of the 5th, the vehicle was located about one mile downstream and the body of the driver 3-4 miles downstream just south of the Park Rd 37/FM 1283 intersection in Bandera County. The driver was a 20 year old male.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding closing Haby Ln. and Bandera Rd. along San Geronimo Creek.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. There was a high water rescue of a vehicle stranded on Blanco Rd. at Meusebach Creek near Camp Bullis.
Thunderstorms produced an estimated two to five inches of rain in three hours. This rain caused flash flooding closing Little Blanco Rd. near Twin Sisters.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding closing roads in northwestern San Antonio.
lsr: A vehicle was swept off Park Road 37 in high water. The vehicle was located about 1 1/2 miles downstream, however a search for the driver continues.
Road closure due to flash flooding.
Little Blanco Road is closed/barricaded road due to fast moving water/flooding. Rainfall amounts range from 2 to almost 5 inches over southern Blanco County over the last 3 hours.
A vehicle was stranded in high water near Blanco Road and Meusebach Creek and a high water rescue was conducted.
There are 8 road closures in Bexar County as of 10:23 PM due flash flooding.
San Antonio Fire Department rescued one person in a flooded drainage ditch near Tioga Drive and Interstate 10.
